notes.title: What do you think about the UI changes?
notes.content:
Hey!

V0.5 patch just dropped with a lot of UI updates, and by popular demand - Subtitles! Thanks to everyone that submitted feedback - whether it was DMs or the Steam Forums, most of the suggestions are now live! Let me know what you think!

As usual, there are still a lot of things to do and the game can still be improved a lot! Have any ideas, complaints, or suggestions? Is there something you want to see in this game? Send me a DM or post on the community forums! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514983/5e39dac4cc92c1857a972ede9c9c124a4cb62e4c.png[/img]

[h2]V0.5 changes:[/h2]
[h3]Demo Specific Changes[/h3]
- "The Demo Buster" final boss no longer bypasses the gate shield spell and no longer 1 shots the gate. My original intention of the demo buster was to be a final boss that is undefeatable, however I found that it was just more frustrating by having an undefeatable boss. Note that the boss is still difficult, and you have to be creative to defeat it! Congradulations to anyone (that didnt cheat :D) that beat the "undefeatable" demo boss before the nerf!
- Disabled all blacksmith upgrades in demo aside from the first one. The upgrades are powerful in the full game, but the demo is not long enough to make good use of them.

[h3]QOL Updates[/h3]
- Subtitles! Yes, about time...Honestly the first version should have had subtitles, but better late than never! Subtitles are currently only available in English, but more language support is coming in the future!
- By popular demand - Added the top section of the hud which shows resources and tower damage at the top of the screen. Mousing over the tower damage at the top will also show you how much damage you are receiving per minute
- Updated the main menu and a bunch of minor UI tweaks
- Added the "+" sign when mousing over the debris, indicating that you are receiving those resources for removing the debris, and not paying
- You can no longer use panic gate heal at full gate HP
- You now get some small feedback when clicking on a building by showing a red highlight around it
- Added a floating icon over every building to find buildings easier
- Right clicking when having a building HUD open will now close it

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed a rare bug that would sometimes start the game with a system being disabled or not working properly
- Fixed a bug where you could not build a tower in an open spot that was clearly open for a tower
- Delete tower button was not working - I never hooked it up....oops! (The hotkey was always working though!)
- Updated collision on some walls as some sections were not properly blocking arrows

[h3]Visual Changes[/h3]
- Improved the quality of shadows on "Ultra" settings. The "High" preset will have the same shadow quality as the "Ultra" preset on previous versions. If I did my optimizations right through, the FPS performance should not be impacted on the Ultra settings. Same FPS, better quality!

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
- Policeman used to absorb first 3 hits without taking damage, it has now been lowered to 1. The policemen were too strong and made the modern age a bit too difficult to transition to
- Balanced a few choices in the diamond store

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Indie Assemble Festival + Demo Launch!
notes.content:
I am very happy to announce that Eternal Siege will be part of the Indie Assemble event being hosted by Excaliber! Check it out here (link may not work until the event starts): https://store.steampowered.com/sale/IndieAssemble


The event starts on May 5th at 10:00 AM PT (7:00 PM CET) and run until May 11th at the same time.

Additionally, I have committed long hours to get an exclusive demo launch, and the hard work has paid off! I was barely able to get the demo finished on time - but it is on track and will launch at the same time as the festival!

The Demo version will be limited and only run up to the Modern Era with a Demo boss at the end. However I left more than half of the systems unlocked so you should get a good idea of how the game feels, just on a shorter time span.

Check out the demo and feel free to give me feedback, even if it is bad! My goal is to make ALL of my projects (including this first project) as best as they can possibly be. Even though this project was a massive learning experience, I will not use a first project as an excuse to make slop. How you do one thing is how you do everything.

V0.4 patch notes (for my lovely full version beta testers) are below. The demo will be launching with the 0.4 version but limited features as per above.


New features
- Demo launch to be available on May 5th!
- Starting in the Roman Era, you can build a bank in the tower area which takes up 4 tower slots. Your investment grows value over time, and the yield depends on the location of the bank

Bug fixes
- If you kill all the hoplites on the hoplite boss wave within a short period, it would stop progressing the game
- Unable to delete the mage tower, instead it would delete something else next to it
- Panic fireball sometimes missed 1-2 units

QOL updates
- Updated more tooltips and hints around some areas that were lacking descriptions
- Simplified a lot of text descriptions in the buildings so they are quicker and easier to read
- Spread out unlocks on modern age so you dont feel overwhelmed with a lot of unlocks all at once
- You now get a prompt when you try to exit the tutorial
- You now get a prompt when you try to exit or restart the game

Balance changes
- Void units damage doubled
- Moved some gathering hut materials closer to where it would make sense (ex: gold nuggets are now near the gold mine)
- Void store - Tank base upgrade increase from +150 to +300
- Void store - Tank multiplier upgrade decreased from +25% to +15%
- Doubled the cost of tank damage multiplier in the oil store
- Bonus waves now have a hard limit of 5 minutes each and are no longer unlimited in time

Visual changes
- Added foliage, rocks, and a few props around the map for visual looks
- Brand new fresh look on all the buildings!
- Roman wall (gate level 2) and Roman towers (tower level 2) got a brand new fresh look as well!
- Added a little bit of special effects when building and deleting towers
- Upgraded the look of the fishing dock and trading dock as well
- Lots of visual UI updates

notes.title: Closed Beta v0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
v0.3 is now live for closed beta testing! Thanks to everyone that gave feedback for all previous versions!

New features
- Added the Abandoned Mines that can be renovated during the dystopian era into the Void Mines
- Added other systems to go along with the void mines: Void Store, Lumber Compressor, Void Units, and soon (TM) the Void Market
- The lighting now subtly changes over time throughout the game to fit the mood better

Bug fixes
- Fixed a bug that was not applying the oil pump speed multiplier properly, so the oil was always pumping at base speed (YIKES!)
- Fixed a bug where the tower range indicator was always a bit shorter than the actual range
- Fixed a bug where the oil rig did not start up again when collecting the oil during the slowing down process
- Fixed a few tooltips with incorrect information

QOL updates
- Camera speed no longer multiplies when changing the game speed
- Added a brightness slider for tank and missile explosions
- Big visual UI update on every single system
- The game now caps at 60 FPS when paused in the main menu
- Added an "Alt" multiplier in the market for x50 purchases in addition to the existing "Shift" x5 multiplier
- Enemy health used to be capped at 2 billion, now its pretty much uncapped
- Reflections should look much better, especially on the water
- Slightly updated the look of the landscape, but more work is still needed
- Added more sounds
- Simplified a lot of landscape collision which should improve the CPU performance
- Finally added camera bounds so you cannot fly outside of the map

Balance changes
- Nerfed the gate regen upgrade from the gold store from +50% regen to +25% regen
- Nerfed the gate regen at level 4 (Modern Gate) from 8 HP/second 6 HP/per second, however it now gives an additional scaling bonus of base hp of +10/minute
- Changed a bunch of prices in the stores for further game balance
- Mage tower spell radius increased at level 1 by 50%
- Mage tower level 2 upgrade now only increases the radius by 25% (down from 50%), but it is still larger than previously
- Lowered all tank attack upgrades cost in the blacksmith by about 30%
- Increased rocket AOE radius from 800 to 900
- Hazmat Suit (Extinction Era) and Police Officer (Modern Age) HP nerfed slightly as they were too powerful

Any suggestions or want to participate in closed beta testing? Send a DM, email, or post in the community forums!

notes.title: Closed Beta v0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
v0.2 is now live for closed beta testing! Thanks to everyone that gave feedback for V0.1!

QOL updates:
- Added range indicator for towers during construction
- Added the ability to change the game speed (0.5x, 1x, 2x) with num pad keys (rebindable)
- Added glowing particles to the gatherables from the gathering hut so youre not playing Wheres Waldo for an hour
- Upgraded the UI look slightly and added more tooltip descriptions
- Added camera controls indicator in the tutorial
- Added a popup box that explains the bonus wave if hints are enabled
- Added indicators in the world and in the UI for when new systems unlock
- When starting the game, you are now given a clear choice to skip the tutorial, where before it was a tiny checkbox

Bug fixes:
- Fixed a bug where you could spawn an infinite amount of tanks in some areas
- Fixed a bug where mage towers didnt unlock properly
- Fixed a few UI elements not scaling properly when changing the UI scale in the settings
- You can now unpause the game when hitting esc while paused in the menu (previously you had to manually hit continue)
- Fixed a bug where you could build an additional tower in the same spot as a mage tower
- Fixed a bug when a boss would hyperspawn 8 waves of units

Balance changes:
- Massively increased the enemy HP scaling as the game was too easy
- Gathering hut initial refresh multiplier increased from +25% to +35%
- Oil rig gathering speed is increased by about 50%
- Tanks oil cost increased from 1,000 to 1,250
- Worker overtime strike time reduced from 10 minutes to 5
- Added additional ways to get more lumber later on in the game


Any suggestions? Feel free to DM me or post on the Steam community forums!

Want to participate in closed beta testing? Send a DM or Email!
